title: NIST WebBook: Zinc is Zn, molecular weight 65.38 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists Zinc as Zn, molecular weight 65.38 amu, CAS 7440-66-6.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for Zinc, CAS Registry Number 7440-66-6, lists molecular formula Zn and molecular weight 65.38 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 63.9291422 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/Zn. The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight. It is also not the standard atomic weight in the NIST isotopic-composition file.
